ConnectionStrings._comment: ROW database only (row_production). The worker refuses any database whose name does not start with row. Set on the server, never committed.

RotaryOrgApi._comment: Set Username/Password via server-only edit — never committed to git.

RotaryOrgSync._SkipCountries: ROW syncs every country EXCEPT these. Clubs in them are dropped from every Rotary.org club list (Services/CountryScope.cs).
RotaryOrgSync._SyncClubsWithNoCountry: false = a club Rotary.org sends without a country is skipped too, because it could be an Indian club.
RotaryOrgSync._NonSyncGraceNights: A club missing from Rotary.org /clubs has its members soft-deleted only after this many nightly runs in a row. Until then it is only listed as Waiting in the email.

Brand._comment: ROW instance brand (Services/Brand.cs). Same keys as the NestJS edition. Deployment values: set per server, e.g. Brand__Domains__AdminOrigin, Brand__Support__Phones__0.

Scope._comment: District 5656 = our own test district (Zone 0, Rotary Club of Thane City View). Exempt: never terminated, never cascaded to non-sync, members may log in.
